title: Edge locations: content close to users

kcs.statement: Edge locations are AWS sites in many more cities than there are Regions, used by CloudFront to cache content and by Route 53 and Global Accelerator to answer and route traffic close to users.
Edge locations do not host general workloads such as EC2 instances or databases; the origin stays in a Region and the edge reduces latency for delivering content to users.
